_provenance: scID -> NSE ticker, resolved from priceapi.moneycontrol.com. Moneycontrol identifies companies by its own code and truncates display names to 15 characters, so neither is usable as a join key. This map is the join. It only grows: a rerun costs one request per never-before-seen company. Entries in `unresolved` had no NSEID (unlisted, BSE-only, or delisted) and are rendered without a ticker rather than guessed at.
